exposure: wave reflections in the umbilical artery (UA)
cohort: The study participants were 241 pregnant women, categorized into control, maternal vascular malperfusion (MVM), and fetal vascular malperfusion (FVM) groups.
finding: Wave reflections in the UA were significantly elevated in women with maternal vascular malperfusion (MVM) or fetal vascular malperfusion (FVM) compared to controls.
